title: I'm working on a multiplayer idle MMORPG inspired by Runescape using Opus 5.5
author: ColonyExodus
selftext:
**You can now try it without signing up.** Hit Play free and you're dropped straight into the Yard as a guest. If you like it, save your progress with a name and email and keep everything you've earned.

**What's new since the first post:**

* **Clue scrolls (smuggled notes):** monsters, thieving and gathering drop notes in four tiers. Follow torn maps, riddles and strange requests, then dig up a contraband stash. Rewards include gold-trimmed armour, rare hats and more.
* **Rare skilling pets:** every skill has its own pet that can turn up while you train, like Pebble the rock for Mining or Magpie for Thieving. There's also a baby Behemoth from the world boss.
* **Prestige:** reach total level 1,500 and you can start your skills over while keeping your items. Each prestige earns a new colour of prestige party hat, a star by your name, and bonus XP in every skill.
* **Goals:** tell your character to keep going "until I have X (item)" or "until level 60", or "until I decide to stop" then walk away,
* **Offline progress that picks up where you left off**, even if the server restarts mid-activity.
* **Loadouts:** save gear setups and swap them with one click.
* **Silver and gold ore** for crafting rings and amulets.
* **Combat quality-of-life:** Ranged and Magic have been added.
* **A proper website** with live high scores for every skill and a devlog: [colonyexodus.com](https://colonyexodus.com/)
* **Also on itch.io:** [colonyexodus.itch.io/colony-exodus](https://colonyexodus.itch.io/colony-exodus)
